entries.source: A family show with dolphins and seals at Türkiye’s largest marine mammal show centre.
entries.translation: A family show with dolphins and seals at Türkiye’s largest marine mammal show centre.

entries.source: Visit Sealanya Dolphinpark in Türkler for a professionally organised dolphin and seal show, with round-trip transfer from your hotel or apartment and insurance included.
entries.translation: Visit Sealanya Dolphinpark in Türkler for a professionally organised dolphin and seal show, with round-trip transfer from your hotel or apartment and insurance included.

entries.source: Sealanya Dolphinpark is located in Türkler, on the Alanya coast, and is presented by Sealanya as Türkiye’s largest marine mammal show centre.
entries.translation: Sealanya Dolphinpark is located in Türkler, on the Alanya coast, and is presented by Sealanya as Türkiye’s largest marine mammal show centre.

entries.source: The approximately 45–55 minute program begins with a seal performance and continues with the dolphin show, including coordinated movements, jumps and trainer interaction.
entries.translation: The approximately 45–55 minute program begins with a seal performance and continues with the dolphin show, including coordinated movements, jumps and trainer interaction.

entries.source: Officially, shows are scheduled every day at 10:30 and 15:00. The departure offered with your booking is confirmed according to transfer availability and the selected date.
entries.translation: Officially, shows are scheduled every day at 10:30 and 15:00. The departure offered with your booking is confirmed according to transfer availability and the selected date.

entries.source: Swimming with dolphins is a separate activity and is not included in the standard show ticket. It requires advance reservation and has additional age, height, swimming ability, pregnancy and health restrictions.
entries.translation: Swimming with dolphins is a separate activity and is not included in the standard show ticket. It requires advance reservation and has additional age, height, swimming ability, pregnancy and health restrictions.

entries.source: Professional photographs with dolphins or seals are also paid separately. Personal photography is not permitted during the dolphin swimming session.
entries.translation: Professional photographs with dolphins or seals are also paid separately. Personal photography is not permitted during the dolphin swimming session.

entries.source: The restrictions for dolphin swimming do not apply to ordinary show attendance. Show times, prices and activities may be changed by Sealanya. Final pickup and program details are confirmed after booking.
entries.translation: The restrictions for dolphin swimming do not apply to ordinary show attendance. Show times, prices and activities may be changed by Sealanya. Final pickup and program details are confirmed after booking.

entries.source: Pickup from your hotel or apartment in the Alanya region. The exact time depends on your location and the confirmed morning or afternoon show session.

entries.source: Entrance assistance, orientation and time to take your seats in the amphitheatre before the performance begins.
entries.translation: Entrance assistance, orientation and time to take your seats in the amphitheatre before the performance begins.

entries.source: The official program begins with the seals, which remain on stage for approximately 20 minutes and perform with their trainers.
entries.translation: The official program begins with the seals, which remain on stage for approximately 20 minutes and perform with their trainers.

entries.source: Dolphins continue the program with coordinated movements, jumps and trainer interaction. The complete seal and dolphin show lasts approximately 45–55 minutes.
entries.translation: Dolphins continue the program with coordinated movements, jumps and trainer interaction. The complete seal and dolphin show lasts approximately 45–55 minutes.

entries.source: Professional photographs with dolphins or seals are available for an additional fee. Pre-booked dolphin swimming starts after the show according to the reservation order.

entries.source: Meet at the confirmed point and return comfortably to your hotel or apartment after the scheduled activities are complete.

entries.source: How long does the show last?
entries.translation: How long does the show last?

entries.source: The official program lasts approximately 45–55 minutes and includes both the seal and dolphin performances.
entries.translation: The official program lasts approximately 45–55 minutes and includes both the seal and dolphin performances.

entries.source: Sealanya officially schedules shows every day at 10:30 and 15:00. Your exact tour departure is confirmed according to the selected date and transfer route.
entries.translation: Sealanya officially schedules shows every day at 10:30 and 15:00. Your exact tour departure is confirmed according to the selected date and transfer route.

entries.source: No. Dolphin swimming is a separate activity, officially priced at €120, and must be reserved in advance because places are limited.
entries.translation: No. Dolphin swimming is a separate activity, officially priced at €120, and must be reserved in advance because places are limited.

entries.source: Children aged 0–5 and pregnant guests are not permitted. Participants must know how to swim; children must meet the park’s height and accompaniment rules. Final approval belongs to Sealanya staff.
entries.translation: Children aged 0–5 and pregnant guests are not permitted. Participants must know how to swim; children must meet the park’s height and accompaniment rules. Final approval belongs to Sealanya staff.

entries.source: Can we take photos with the animals?
entries.translation: Can we take photos with the animals?

entries.source: Professional photographs with dolphins or seals may be purchased after the show. Personal cameras are not allowed during the dolphin swimming session.
entries.translation: Professional photographs with dolphins or seals may be purchased after the show. Personal cameras are not allowed during the dolphin swimming session.

entries.source: Yes. Our €35 adult tour package includes round-trip transfer, show entrance, insurance and booking assistance.
entries.translation: Yes. Our €35 adult tour package includes round-trip transfer, show entrance, insurance and booking assistance.

entries.source: What are the age and height rules for dolphin swimming?
entries.translation: What are the age and height rules for dolphin swimming?

entries.source: Children aged 0–5 are not permitted. Children aged 6–7 may participate only with a paying adult. Participants must be able to swim, and children must meet the park’s minimum height requirement of more than 1.20 m. Final approval belongs to Sealanya staff.
entries.translation: Children aged 0–5 are not permitted. Children aged 6–7 may participate only with a paying adult. Participants must be able to swim, and children must meet the park’s minimum height requirement of more than 1.20 m. Final approval belongs to Sealanya staff.

entries.source: Are jewellery and sunscreen allowed during dolphin swimming?
entries.translation: Are jewellery and sunscreen allowed during dolphin swimming?

entries.source: No. Jewellery, watches and sunscreen must be removed before the swimming session. A life jacket is compulsory.
entries.translation: No. Jewellery, watches and sunscreen must be removed before the swimming session. A life jacket is compulsory.

entries.source: Can the dolphin swimming fee be refunded after the program starts?
entries.translation: Can the dolphin swimming fee be refunded after the program starts?

entries.source: No. Once the program has started, refusal or withdrawal does not provide a right to a refund.
entries.translation: No. Once the program has started, refusal or withdrawal does not provide a right to a refund.

entries.source: Guests must not feed or touch the animals unless instructed and supervised by trainers.
entries.translation: Guests must not feed or touch the animals unless instructed and supervised by trainers.

entries.source: Smoking is prohibited in the amphitheatre and near the pools.
entries.translation: Smoking is prohibited in the amphitheatre and near the pools.

entries.source: Participants must know how to swim. A life jacket is compulsory, and the pool is approximately 6 metres deep.
entries.translation: Participants must know how to swim. A life jacket is compulsory, and the pool is approximately 6 metres deep.
